messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — we need to lock the Q2 GTM roadmap by EOD tomorrow. Top buckets: sales targets (SMB vs Enterprise), Redwood Optimize 1.2 launch date, PLG experiments for trial conversion, and the field enablement pack. Drop ownership + any blockers now please.

Liam O'Connor: I can own the sales targets. Need final input from revenue ops on ARR uplift model by noon. Pending: updated funnel conversion numbers from analytics.

Sofia Chen: I'll take Optimize 1.2 launch comms + promo plan. Question — are we shipping the two feature flags (auto-batching suggestion + quantization presets) in GA or soft-launch?

Maya Patel: @Sofia prefer GA for auto-batching suggestion, soft-launch for quantization presets (feature flagged). We want clean messaging on cost/sla tradeoffs.

Rajiv Kumar: For PLG experiments I propose 2 arms: (A) trial with preconfigured templates + in-product tour, (B) trial without templates but with targeted email nudges. Hypothesis: templates reduce time-to-value and increase paid conversion. We'll need analytics events + cohort tags. I can run the experiment but need one engineer for product hooks (2w).

Elena Gomez: Enablement pack: field playbook, 3 battlecards (SMB, Mid-market, Enterprise), two 60s demo scripts, and a quick deck for AE onboarding. I need final feature matrix from Product by EOD today or I can't finish the battlecards.

Liam O'Connor: Revenue ops — blocking items posted in #revenue-ops. Quick ask: can marketing confirm uplift targets by noon so we can model comp?

Sofia Chen: Copy — I'll sync with Product now. Also planning a short launch landing page + 2 hero case studies. Target to go live the same day as GA.

Maya Patel: Action list: 
- Liam: finalize targets + share numbers (owner) — due today 12:00 PT.
- Sofia: launch comms + landing page (owner) — due tomorrow 10:00 PT.
- Rajiv: PLG experiment plan + infra checklist (owner) — draft by EOD.
- Elena: enablement pack draft (owner) — draft by tomorrow 09:00 PT.
- Product: feature matrix + confirmation on presets GA/flag (owner) — by today EOD.

enablement-bot: Reminder scheduled: "GTM Q2 finalization review" tomorrow 09:30 PT in #marketing.

Maya Patel: If anyone cannot meet these SLAs, flag now. Otherwise I'll compile a final roadmap doc after the noon inputs and post to the repo + sales channel. :thumbsup: 

Sofia Chen: I might need a quick copy review from Elena for the landing page — pinging after product confirmation.

Rajiv Kumar: Noted. I'll tag engineering and open the experiment PR today.

Liam O'Connor: Will post the revenue numbers in thread in 30m. Thanks all.
